Remedy: «Este dispositivo ya tiene un inicio de sesión más reciente de la misma cuenta de Radient» carries the English predicate (already present, on this device, same account); «Reconecta … a ese inicio de sesión» names the pin move, not an authentication. adjudications.question: es ships two renderings of 'phone access': «acceso telefónico» (mobile.setup, wire.tunnel_setup) and «acceso desde el teléfono» (`cli.mobile_help.mobile`). Did matching the namespace make the right call?
adjudications.rationale: Yes. «acceso telefónico» is the feature's name in this namespace (15 shipped titles plus six non-title keys — `applying`, `busy`, `in_progress`, `quote_unread`, `unexpected_failure`, `corrupt_intent`) and in `wire.tunnel_setup` (3 keys); counted in this tree, not estimated; `cli.mobile_help.mobile` is a one-line help blurb about accessing the sessions *from* the phone, i.e. a different predicate, and it is untouched by this lane. Matching the namespace keeps these three keys inside one vocabulary; changing them here would have created the split inside mobile.setup instead of at the edge of it. Measured: fr/ru/vi are single-term across mobile.setup, wire.tunnel_setup and cli.mobile_help, so es is the only one of these four locales whose tree still carries the older variant — a pre-existing, out-of-scope es cleanup, not a defect of these keys.

findings.string: El acceso telefónico debe reconectarse al inicio de sesión más reciente de este dispositivo
findings.issue: The translator receipt's flag 3 says es 'kept a comparative, as in the English; unlike fr I did not narrow it to a superlative'. That is true of the remedy sentence («un inicio de sesión más reciente de la misma cuenta», indefinite, comparative) but not of the title or the receipt: with the definite article plus the «de este dispositivo» complement, «al inicio de sesión más reciente de este dispositivo» is the Spanish superlative, i.e. the same construction fr was flagged for.
findings.assessment: Not a copy defect: exactly one live same-account row can be the referent (`local_operator/providers/account_successor.py` requires `len(candidates) == 1`), so 'the most recent one on this device' and 'this device's newer one' pick out the same row in every state this plan can be in. Recorded so the next reader does not rely on the receipt's claim when comparing es with fr. No edit requested.

findings.string: … — misma cuenta, misma dirección de teléfono.
findings.issue: Term variance inside the namespace: the same object ships as «Dirección del teléfono» (four keys: reservation_saved, reservation_existing, reservation_unconfirmed and the stage_reservation fragment) and as «la dirección del teléfono»/«la dirección de tu teléfono» inline (stage_reservation, consent). The new tail uses the article-less compound «dirección de teléfono».
findings.assessment: Reads acceptably in the elliptical «misma cuenta, misma X» frame and the referent is unmistakable; a future es wave may align it to «la misma dirección del teléfono», which is the form the namespace ships for the object. Not worth a remediation round on its own.
